entries.title: Gas Molecules in a Compressing Piston Chamber
entries.description: A transparent cylinder filled with many bouncing spheres (gas molecules) under a sliding piston that slowly moves inward, increasing collision frequency, temperature color of particles, and a side pressure gauge that rises as volume shrinks.
entries.seed: Gas Molecules in a Compressing Piston Chamber: A transparent cylinder filled with many bouncing spheres (gas molecules) under a sliding piston that slowly moves inward, increasing collision frequency, temperature color of particles, and a side pressure gauge that rises as volume shrinks.

entries.title: Hydraulic Press Crushing a Metal Block
entries.description: Two thick plates slowly move together to compress a colored metal cube between them, with the cube squashing, bulging sideways, changing color where stress is highest, and a bar graph showing applied pressure over time.

entries.title: Submarine Hull Under Increasing Ocean Depth
entries.description: A cylindrical submarine descends through a light blue water column where water pressure increases with depth, causing the hull to slightly deform inward, external arrows grow and darken with depth, and internal air particles compress and speed up.

entries.title: Lungs Inflating and Deflating with Air Pressure
entries.description: A semi-transparent chest cavity shows two elastic sacs (lungs) that expand and contract as air particles flow in and out through a trachea tube, with internal pressure displayed as a rising/falling meter and arrows indicating airflow direction.

entries.title: Sponge Being Compressed and Releasing Water
entries.description: A porous 3D sponge block between two plates is squeezed so that blue water particles are pushed out and drip down, then when released, the sponge re-expands and slowly reabsorbs nearby floating droplets.

entries.title: Car Tire Under Changing Load and Pressure
entries.description: A car wheel rests on the ground with a visible translucent tire; as load increases from above, the tire flattens at the bottom, internal air particles compress and move faster, and a side gauge shows tire pressure rising and dropping when a valve opens.

entries.title: Earth’s Crust Compression Forming Folded Mountains
entries.description: Two large crustal plates slowly converge and push a flexible terrain strip that wrinkles and rises into mountains, with stress lines colored from green to red and small labeled arrows showing compression directions.

entries.title: Shock Wave Compression from an Explosion
entries.description: A small central detonation in air emits an expanding spherical pressure wave that compresses and briefly displaces nearby particles, drawn as a semi-transparent shell with changing thickness, color, and labeled pressure ring.

entries.title: Syringe Plunger Compressing Liquid into a Narrow Tube
entries.description: A transparent syringe shows a plunger moving inward to compress a nearly incompressible colored liquid, forcing it through a narrow tube where velocity increases, pressure drops, and tiny tracer particles leave glowing trails.

entries.title: Foam Block Under Cyclic Compression
